readiness: research; no installed geometry authorized by this evidence
target: 1994 Ford F-150 2WD 4.9L EFI, M5OD-R2; exact engine build and matched tube/indicator identity unverified

sources.title: Ford 1995 F-Series/Bronco Powertrain Drivetrain, Engine 4.9L Six-Cylinder
sources.locator: 03-01A, Oil Level Indicator Tube, printed 03-01A-37 / figure A23872-A; engine-out repetition near 03-01A-68 to 69
sources.kind: primary Ford service-manual content in third-party reprint, adjacent model year
sources.access: Indexed text inspected, including procedure and figure callout table. Full open exceeded tool content limit; actual figure pixels NOT inspected. Search exact title plus Oil Level Indicator Tube to reproduce.
facts: Lower retaining nut is unscrewed to release tube.
Upper tube bracket fastens at valve pushrod-cover retainer.
Callouts identify dipstick 6750, tube 6754, retainer 6C517, pushrod cover 6519 and stamped nut 370786-S8.
Lower nut and tube bracket are listed as parts of 6754, not independently identified service numbers.
limits: 1995 manual is not exact 1994 applicability proof.
No tube centerline dimensions, bore, seat section, thread pitch or independently inspected illustration supplied.
Do not transfer torque or OCR hardware-size text into this project's 1994 repair guidance.

sources.kind: supplier description of its replacement engine; replacement comparison
facts: 1994 F-150 4.9L VIN Y replacement listing describes rear-side dipstick entry through block.
limits: AIR-in-head application differs from some 1994 engines; broad reman interchange is not installed casting identification.
No measured station or side-to-side coordinate.

facts: Later manifold-AIR 4.9L replacement also specifies rear-side block entry.
limits: Adjacent-year comparison only, not new dimensional evidence.

facts: Oil-level tube base number 6754; E7TZ-6754-A exists as service-number lead.
limits: Current fitment table lists broad 1987-1989 combinations and omits 4.9L; it does not establish 1994 fitment.
An older forum lead naming this part is not treated as authority.

facts: Listed F2TZ-6754-A is associated with 5.0L; F2TZ-6754-B and F3TZ-6754-A with 5.8L variants.
Base number 7A228 entries are transmission filler tubes, not this engine-oil tube.
limits: Absence of 4.9 tube on this page does not prove no tube existed.
Do not adopt package dimensions as manufactured tube dimensions.

facts: Listing title describes 1987-95 F150/F250/F350 4.9L 300 dipstick and tube.
limits: Direct item page inaccessible; no specimen photo or stamping inspected. Do not use for shape or fit.
Aggregated eBay product page 10000661764 mixes dipsticks and throttle cables and is not reliable identity evidence.

interface_decision.lower_entry: Use rear-side block-entry architecture as working comparison-supported hypothesis; do not cut oil pan or invent a block bore from rejected blade pose.
interface_decision.side: Pushrod-cover/cam/distributor side from manual bracket attachment; existing CAD convention maps that face to +Y. Truck RH/LH label and precise station await direct illustration or owner inspection.
interface_decision.upper_anchor: A pushrod-cover retainer, not an arbitrary valve-cover screw or intake bolt. Exact one of six current cover stations remains unverified.
interface_decision.lower_retention: Threaded retaining nut belongs to tube assembly in adjacent-year Ford manual. Seat shape, thread and seal method remain unknown.
interface_decision.secondary_seal: No separate O-ring/ferrule identified by accepted evidence; absence from inspected table is not proof of absence.
interface_decision.matched_identity: 6754 tube and 6750 indicator must be checked as a matched pair; existing E9TE-6750-DA specimen does not determine tube number or calibrated insertion length.

owner_photo_review.result: Both original bay views inspected again. No securely traced handle-to-tube-to-block route or identifiable lower seat; no measured coordinates extracted.
owner_photo_review.distribution: Owner photos stay local; no copied image or crop included.

required_before_modeling: Obtain exact 1994 service illustration or compare figure A23872-A to owner's lower entry and upper bracket.
Record lower seat center/axis relative to pan rail and rear block face; confirm threaded versus press-fit details visually.
Identify upper retaining station and measure bracket plane/hole; reconcile modeled pushrod-cover bolts with retainer6C517 architecture.
Measure tube OD/ID, seating engagement, mouth datum and centerline bends from matched specimen; determine join construction and lower nut captivity.
Measure seated indicator stop-to-tip and original marked band; retain current rejected trial pose as rejected.

offline_1994_archive_review.method: Enumerated extracted files with rg --files --no-ignore; searched HTML for dipstick, oil-level-indicator, 6754, 6C517 and A23872; checked ZIP directory for unextracted tube pages; read relevant service pages and visually inspected their four local PNGs using view_image.
offline_1994_archive_review.result: No engine-oil dipstick/tube installation page or A23872-A attachment diagram was located in this offline 1994 CHARM bundle. Only automatic-transmission dipstick parts pages and unrelated electrical oil-level warning pages were located under corresponding names. This is a scoped archive finding, not proof that a Ford1994 procedure or component does not exist.
offline_1994_archive_review.applicability_change: None: exact1994 tube attachment not established. Adjacent1995 retention architecture remains explicitly adjacent-year evidence.

reviewed_pages.observation: Engine removal/reinstallation procedure; no engine-oil tube attachment instructions or tube illustration.
Lifter procedure includes pushrod-cover removal, but does not identify tube support retainer or station.
Pan procedure and two figures inspected. No dipstick attachment step or identified guide-tube port.
Lubrication schematic inspected; oil galleries, bearings, pump and filter, no identified dipstick tube.
Electrical oil-level warning diagnosis; not a guide-tube installation procedure or dimensional source.
Numbers F4TZ7A020A/E7TZ7A020D/E9TZ7A020B are transmission indicators; excluded from engine tube identification.

viewed_images.observation: Hydraulic lifter exploded parts, no tube attachment.
Rear pan seal detail, no dipstick attachment.
Oil pan exploded installation drawing; no labeled dipstick tube or entry. Its omission does not prove absence of a port.
Oil galleries and bearing lubrication diagram, no tube placement.

offline_1994_archive_review.redistribution: No manual file or image copied. Paths/hashes identify local evidence only; future users need lawful source access.
